action.objective: Castle kingside to secure the king and connect the rooks with a verified, safe move.
action.rationale: e1g1 is the only commit_ready move and the reserved/top suggestion. Broad depth-2 ranked it top (80, exact), and single-candidate verification completed at depth 3 with a positive exact score (36, PV e1g1 Nc6 Nf3). Safety is complete: no immediate mate, no checking-reply refutation, no forced mate against White. Castling removes the king from the center after 12...c5 has challenged the position, connects the rooks, and is consistent with undeveloped c1 bishop still to come. No stronger exact evidence exists for an alternative and analysis nodes are exhausted (analysis_nodes_available=0), so I commit the verified move without a continuation.
